# Mark Pianelli Salon

> Hair color & cutting studio based in Dripping Springs, Texas. Mark Pianelli is a perfectionist colorist and cutter in Dripping Springs, known for balayage, color melts and corrections, steel-blue ombré and blunt cuts on super-thick hair.

- Phone: (214) 240-0043

## Services
- Balayage & color melts: Hand-painted balayage and seamless color melts, even on fine hair.
- Color correction: Fixing uneven or brassy color, in as many sessions as it takes.
- Precision cuts: Blunt bobs, long layers and thinning for very thick hair.
- Men's & kids' cuts: Clean men's cuts and kids' cuts, done exactly as asked.

## About
Mark Pianelli Salon is Mark's studio on Hays Street in Dripping Springs, convenient for Driftwood, Bee Cave and Wimberley. He does balayage, highlights, color melts, color correction and precision cuts for women, men and kids. Clients call him a perfectionist and a master of his craft. He listens, takes his time, and has rehabilitated hair that other salons couldn't fix. Some clients have sat in his chair for four years or more.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment at Mark Pianelli Salon?
  A: Appointments are best. Call (214) 240-0043 or book online and Mark will confirm by text.
- Q: Where is Mark Pianelli Salon?
  A: 101 Hays St, Ste 412, Dripping Springs, TX. Parking is right outside.
- Q: Do you cut and color all hair types?
  A: Yes. Women's, men's and kids' cuts, color, highlights and styling for every hair type.
- Q: Can I bring inspiration photos?
  A: Please do. Photos help your stylist match the cut or color you have in mind.
- Q: What do clients say about Mark?
  A: Mark Pianelli Salon is rated 4.9 stars from 33 Yelp reviews. Clients mention perfectionist detail, color that fixes what other salons couldn't, and a stylist who listens.
